summary: Platform engineer with eleven years spent making other people's deploys boring: build isolation, deterministic artefacts, and observability that answers questions instead of generating dashboards. Comfortable owning a system end to end, and comfortable saying no to a dependency.

highlights: Cut median build time from 41 minutes to 6 by making the pipeline hermetic and pinning every toolchain input by digest.
Introduced a one-container-per-render isolation model, which removed an entire class of cross-job leakage reports.
Wrote the internal reproducibility standard now cited by four other teams.
Ran the on-call rotation for a ledger processing 1.4M transactions per day with a 99.98% availability target.
Reduced paging volume by 62% by fixing 9 alert rules that had never once indicated a user-visible problem.
Built the first version of the job-ingestion service, still in production.
Mentored four engineers, two of whom are now senior engineers elsewhere.
